title: UJT - Immortal Tamed Pets
description: A simple mod that makes any pet or animal that has been tamed immortal by mimicking what the player's creative mode does.
body:
A simple mod that makes any pet or animal that has been tamed immortal by mimicking what the player's creative mode does.

It applies to any vanilla and modded pets as long as they were coded to be tamable and or use tamable animal as hierarchy parent.
